messages:
tara_pm: Quick pre-prod acceptance pass for the Redwood Private launch tomorrow — can we run a focused gate check on SLA, docs, support, monitoring, and pricing? I did a sweep and flagged a handful of items below. @mike_eng @li_sre @natalie_support @andre_sales

mike_eng: SLA update — infra validated the latency SLOs on the dedicated pool under expected traffic. We saw 99.9p tail spikes during the 2x load run (KV cache cold-start). Need legal to sign off on the exception clause that allows brief degradation during cache warmup. Also: can we confirm rollback policy is documented?

li_sre: Monitoring: dashboards are wired into the Console for the main routes. Two gaps: (1) KV cache miss traces are not surfaced to per-route dashboards, (2) alerting thresholds currently use a flat token-rate heuristic; suggest moving to p50/p95/p99 latency bands for SLO alerts. I'll add an alert for cache-miss-rate > 5%/5m.

natalie_support: Support readiness: playbooks + escalation tree drafted and shared in the ops-runbook. We have 24/7 oncall coverage for the first 72h, w/ rotation drafted. Missing: canned billing responses (questions about reserved capacity commit vs hosted overage), and a short troubleshooting flow for when customers hit model fallbacks (how to interpret fallback reasons).

andre_sales: Pricing: public pricing page is updated, but we still need the migration FAQ and an example invoice line for dedicated commits. Legal is still eyeballing the enterprise discount terms. Also ask: do we have a recommended default quantization profile to call out to customers to reduce cost?

ops-bot: deploy-batch: preflight CI passed for release/2026-03-20, infra deploy window scheduled 02:00 UTC.

tara_pm: Thanks. Proposing a 1-hour pre-launch sync at 22:00 UTC to close blockers. Quick action list I want visible in-thread: 
```
- mike_eng: legal SLA exception clause + rollback documentation (EOD)
- li_sre: surface KV cache misses to console + add cache-miss alert (in prod by 21:00 UTC)
- natalie_support: final canned billing/troubleshooting responses + triage matrix (share link)
- andre_sales: migration FAQ draft + invoice example lines + recommended quantization profile
- mike_eng & li_sre: create a short runbook entry for the 99.9p tail spike mitigation steps
```

mike_eng: Will do the rollback doc + runbook. Legal pinged (added to thread) — if they don't clear the clause by EOD we should include an explicit customer-facing note in the outage section of the SLA.

li_sre: I'll push the cache tracing and alert, then post a link to the dashboard. If we don't reduce cache-miss rate we should enable prefix caching on the most common routes as a fallback.

natalie_support: Sharing canned responses now: https://redwood.docs/support/canned-responses (draft). Adding billing FAQ items about committed vs usage billing.

andre_sales: I'll attach a short FAQ + invoice samples by 18:00 PST. Re: quantization profile — recommending `int8-q4_0` as default for now, with notes about quality regression testing.

tara_pm: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker that prevents a listed item from being done, drop it here and we'll triage during the 22:00 sync. Otherwise see you in the quick sync — aiming for a clean production acceptance gate. :white_check_mark:
